Components are reduced and costs called estimates; no labor allocation/total demonstrates fit. N2-F2 weakens the asserted backup support story.
Phone retry/reconnect and picker/AT tasks are specified; full offline operation is deferred. No executed usability/conformance evidence.
Availability is private, fields/custom topics require authorization and clients see own status. Notification payload detail could be clearer; no actual leakage is proved.
Exact tokens/free text and hard eligibility before fairness are explicit.
Declared estimate, completion and invoice flag/export are kept without computed pay; payroll-consuming CSV wording remains loose.
UNFILLED reason/review cannot silently turn into a match; future user test has an independent misreading oracle.
Member choices and configuration are retained; off/ask-first are initial fail-safe behavior, not observed approval.
Board metrics/export and later engine spending decisions retain the review boundary.

plan_dispositions.exact_frozen_text: Track an assignment from request through offer, acceptance, completion, and invoice readiness.
plan_dispositions.independent_judgment: Request-to-invoice workflow is retained with travel annotation and a reasoned UNFILLED state. Explicit expiry/decline/cancel handling and human review do not imply availability. Routing and solver services are no longer required R1 mechanisms.

plan_dispositions.exact_frozen_text: Detect overlapping offers and accepted assignments across coordinators.
plan_dispositions.independent_judgment: Detection is retained for UX, while the offer commit must prevent conflicting active holds. PocketBase is the selected single transactional writer; idempotency and history handling are specified. PostgreSQL exclusion is a conditional fallback. This is a plausible design under documented transaction behavior, not an executed guarantee.

plan_dispositions.exact_frozen_text: Limit client and meeting details to the coordinator and assigned interpreter roles that need them.
plan_dispositions.independent_judgment: Availability non-enumerability is correctly included alongside names/topics. Collection rules, field projection and custom-topic authorization are separated. Exact-address-at-offer versus after-acceptance is appropriately a cooperative disclosure decision: travel assessment can need location before acceptance. Coordinator-full remains a design assumption that needs actual operational scope, not proof that everyone needs all data.

plan_dispositions.exact_frozen_text: Record communication mode and access arrangements as structured assignment requirements.
plan_dispositions.independent_judgment: Controlled vocabulary plus exact free-text arrangements preserve client requirements. Hard eligibility precedes fairness under every toggle. Capability and vocabulary governance remain user decisions, with no invented clinical credential guarantee. APG checks are task proposals, not conformance certification.

plan_dispositions.exact_frozen_text: Automated client confirmations and reassignment authority are cooperative policy decisions.
plan_dispositions.independent_judgment: The cooperative chooses confirmation and reassignment policy; OFF/ASK-first are safe initial configurable choices pending its decision. Approved branches require preferences, reason/notice and audit. The final does not present an actual member vote.

plan_dispositions.exact_frozen_text: Travel estimation rules and any payroll connection are outside the defined first release.
plan_dispositions.independent_judgment: Manual declared duration/method/timestamp reconciles tracking an estimate with excluding estimation rules. Automated routing is R2. Payroll calculation is excluded; invoice export is retained. Describing a separate payroll process consuming a CSV is a loose boundary description, not an implemented payroll connection or calculation.

validation_coverage.assessment: Reads, hashes, inherited primary excerpts and static reasoning only; no runtime witnesses. The evaluator independently checks major source claims and does not accept author exit-status or hash consistency as product quality.

Real concurrent offers, sole writer, exactly one hold and duplicate-free retry distinguish check-then-write races. A persistent-state and losing-user result oracle is proposed; V1 must use the actual implementation and pinned release.

Half-open adjacency and inactive history versus active offers discriminate wrong bounds and predicates. PostgreSQL syntax is already documented; runtime exclusion and adapted PocketBase state behavior remain proposals.
Manual label/method/timestamp and unknown handling apply to R1; engine units/profile sensitivity are separate optional gates, preserving release applicability.
List/count/field/realtime/custom topic/error/URL privacy checks discriminate several leak paths and correct status-code exceptions; no actual redaction guarantee follows from their proposal.

Keyboard/SR interaction and exact client requirement tokens plus ineligible-before-fairness checks have meaningful task/eligibility oracles. A custom div is not intrinsically inaccessible; success depends on behavior.
Observed user misreading of UNFILLED and per-policy message/override counts are stronger oracles than merely checking status strings or test process success.
Phone throttling/reconnect, visible pending/failure and reused idempotency keys test the stated R1 recovery mechanism; full offline queueing is not promised.

Reproduction of board metrics from event logs with no PII is a meaningful independent export oracle. It does not exercise invoice CSV completeness/rate-reference mapping despite the invoice section pointing to it.

method_clues.observed: Exact paths/stage assignments identify control as research→critic→fresh reviser and treatment as retained research author incorporating a critic. N1/N2 labels cannot make the comparison fully blind. These method clues were not a scientific scoring criterion.

comparative_assessment.reason: Neither arm is a full-quality pass. Two FAIL labels do not imply equal quality. N1 has a more cautious architecture/vendor selection gate and explicit stage/payload privacy; N2 has a more concrete single-store, availability-entry and phone/idempotency design, but unsound comparator reasoning and backup supportability. These are distinct supported observations, not an overall speed/quality victory.

scope_limits: Only exact B-05 inputs, original I05 brief/plan and relevant public primary evidence were used. No candidate repair or science feedback was sent.
All available final/stage/source-index text was reviewed; byte-identical source copies were compared. The frozen N2 critique contains a literal truncation marker, not a reviewer-imposed output cap.

Old Cal.com GitBook could not be independently retrieved; its bounded frozen primary excerpts support the historical fairness pair only. Current vendor releases/features directly test whole-product conclusions.
No application/runtime sandbox exists; no experimental behavior, merged fix, actual support cost, qualified accessibility result or legal assessment was manufactured.

Public moving documentation is identified by observed version/edition/access date and stable release sources where available. Exact release implementation still requires the candidate’s proposed gate.
No R9/ledger protocol, nested worker, account/config/service/Git/canon edit or executable download was used.
evaluation_started_at_basis: First observed native Goal activation; unobserved startup overhead is not inferred.
